'''Docking Bay 41''' was a holding bay in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] spaceport on [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] illegally used the [[Telesponder|identification profile]] from the ship docked here in order to escape from [[Docking Bay 45]] in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].
